description: Operational, Environmental, and Maintenance Data for Hydropower Plants – Di-Hydro Project is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Institut Mines-Télécom, Centre for Research and Technology Hellas. This dataset provides a structured collection of raw and semantically processed data related to the operation, maintenance, monitoring, and infrastructure of hydropower plants, developed within the scope of the EU-funded Di-Hydro project. The dataset includes both: Static data, such as descriptions of HPPs, dams, generators, penstocks, and associated assets, digitized into NGSI-LD entities. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
